appointments_slot_on_visit_date.name: appointments_slot_on_visit_date
appointments_slot_on_visit_date.value: "appointments"."slot_start" IS NULL OR "appointments"."visit_date" = ("appointments"."slot_start" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date

appointments_checked_in_fields.name: appointments_checked_in_fields
appointments_checked_in_fields.value: "appointments"."status" NOT IN ('checked_in', 'in_consultation', 'completed') OR ("appointments"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."token_no" IS NOT NULL)

appointments_cancel_reason_required.name: appointments_cancel_reason_required
appointments_cancel_reason_required.value: "appointments"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("appointments"."cancel_reason") <> '')

stock_transfers_fields_match_status.name: stock_transfers_fields_match_status
stock_transfers_fields_match_status.value:
CASE "stock_transfers"."status"
        WHEN 'dispatched' THEN "stock_transfers"."received_by" IS NULL AND "stock_transfers"."rejected_by" IS NULL
        WHEN 'received' THEN "stock_transfers"."received_by" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_transfers"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_transfers"."rejected_by" IS NULL
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN "stock_transfers"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_transfers"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_transfers"."received_by" IS NULL
          AND length(trim(coalesce("stock_transfers"."rejection_reason", ''))) > 0
      END

vital_signs_plausible.name: vital_signs_plausible
vital_signs_plausible.value:
("vital_signs"."temp_c" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."temp_c" BETWEEN 30 AND 45)
        AND ("vital_signs"."pulse" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."pulse" BETWEEN 20 AND 250)
        AND ("vital_signs"."bp_sys" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."bp_sys" BETWEEN 50 AND 260)
        AND ("vital_signs"."bp_dia" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."bp_dia" BETWEEN 20 AND 160)
        AND ("vital_signs"."resp_rate" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."resp_rate" BETWEEN 4 AND 80)
        AND ("vital_signs"."spo2" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."spo2" BETWEEN 50 AND 100)
        AND ("vital_signs"."weight_kg" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."weight_kg" BETWEEN 0.3 AND 400)
        AND ("vital_signs"."height_cm" IS NULL OR "vital_signs"."height_cm" BETWEEN 20 AND 250)

invoice_items_typed_source.name: invoice_items_typed_source
invoice_items_typed_source.value:
CASE "invoice_items"."source_type"
        WHEN 'consultation' THEN "invoice_items"."consultation_appointment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_items"."dispensing_line_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_items"."lab_order_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'dispensing' THEN "invoice_items"."dispensing_line_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_items"."consultation_appointment_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_items"."lab_order_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'lab' THEN "invoice_items"."lab_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_items"."consultation_appointment_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_items"."dispensing_line_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "invoice_items"."lab_order_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_items"."consultation_appointment_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_items"."dispensing_line_id" IS NULL
      END

lab_orders_fields_match_status.name: lab_orders_fields_match_status
lab_orders_fields_match_status.value:
("lab_orders"."status" IN ('collected', 'resulted', 'verified')) <= ("lab_orders"."collected_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("lab_orders"."status" IN ('resulted', 'verified')) <= ("lab_orders"."resulted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("lab_orders"."status" = 'verified') = ("lab_orders"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("lab_orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("lab_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("lab_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR length(trim(coalesce("lab_orders"."cancel_reason", ''))) > 0)

lab_test_parameters_ref_order.name: lab_test_parameters_ref_order
lab_test_parameters_ref_order.value: "lab_test_parameters"."ref_low" IS NULL OR "lab_test_parameters"."ref_high" IS NULL OR "lab_test_parameters"."ref_low" <= "lab_test_parameters"."ref_high"

attendance_time_order.name: attendance_time_order
attendance_time_order.value: "attendance"."check_in" IS NULL OR "attendance"."check_out" IS NULL OR "attendance"."check_in" <= "attendance"."check_out"

expenses_decision_fields.name: expenses_decision_fields
expenses_decision_fields.value: ("expenses"."status" <> 'submitted') = ("expenses"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

leave_requests_decision_fields.name: leave_requests_decision_fields
leave_requests_decision_fields.value: ("leave_requests"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
